About Me

I’m a results-driven Business Analyst with graduate training in Applied Business Analytics and a record of improving performance through data-driven insights and process optimization.
I transform complex datasets into clear narratives and decision support that improve efficiency, reduce risk, and drive measurable impact.

I combine technical proficiency in Python, R, SQL, Power BI/Tableau, and Excel with strong communication and leadership skills—bridging the gap between data, strategy, and execution.
